paper_id: Integrating Tree Path in Transformer for Code Representation
title: Integrating Tree Path in Transformer for Code Representation
motivation: 代码结构信息（AST路径）难以被序列模型捕获，现有方法缺乏上下文建模或全局结构建模能力
problem_framing: 如何将AST中的相对路径和绝对路径编码融入Transformer的注意力机制
key_insight: 相对/绝对路径编码可类比NLP中的相对/绝对位置编码，直接修改注意力分数实现结构归纳偏置
method_signature: TPTrans：通过修改注意力QK/V矩阵，将AST相对/绝对路径编码融入自注意力
evaluation_criteria: 代码摘要任务（方法名预测），精确率/召回率/F1评估
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: JavaScript数据集表现较差；两种路径编码存在特征重叠，绝对路径增益微弱
evidence_for_taste: Code2seq lacks the modelling of context
GNNs tends to be local and struggle to leverage long-range interactions
the different node combinations of paths contain plenty of structure information
the overall performance of TPTrans and TPTrans-α does not differ so much
the improvement brought by absolute path becomes smaller
these two kinds of paths are not orthogonal and much feature overlap indeed exists
thinking_moves: 类比NLP中位置编码方法，将路径编码迁移到Transformer
通过消融实验逐步移除路径编码子模块，验证各部分贡献
对比相对路径与绝对路径的实验差异，分析特征重叠关系
将复杂问题分解为可独立验证的组件（路径编码、归一化、模型深度）
